sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 483 was established by Ordinance No. 23212, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 13, 1997. Ordinance No. 23212 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 483 is established on property generally located on the northwest line of Lovers Lane, northeast of Argo Street. The size of PD 483 is approximately 3.6587 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For multifamily uses, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 483A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other permitted uses, the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a conceptual plan, development plan, site analysis plan, or landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Agricultural uses.

-- None permitted.

(b) Commercial and business service uses.

-- Catering service. -- Custom business services. -- Electronics service center. -- Medical or scientific laboratory. [SUP]

(c) Industrial uses.

-- None permitted.

(d) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Adult day care facility. -- Child-care facility. [SUP] -- Church. -- College, university, or seminary. -- Community service center. [SUP] -- Convent or monastery. -- Hospital. [SUP] -- Library, art gallery, or museum. -- Public or private school. [SUP]

(e) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(f) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Temporary construction or sales office.

(g) Office uses.

-- Financial institution without drive-in window. -- Financial institution with drive-in window. [DIR] -- Medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center. [DIR] -- Office.

(h) Recreation uses.

-- Country club with private membership. -- Private recreation center, club, or area. -- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(i) Residential uses.

-- College dormitory, fraternity or sorority house. [SUP] -- Multifamily.

(j) Retail and personal service uses.

-- Animal shelter or clinic without outside run. [SUP] -- Auto service center. [RAR] -- Car wash. [RAR] -- Dry cleaning or laundry store. -- Furniture store. -- General merchandise or food store 3,500 square feet or less. -- General merchandise or food store greater than 3,500 square feet. -- Home improvement center, lumber, brick, or building materials sales yard. [DIR] -- Household equipment and appliance repair.

-- Liquor store. -- Mortuary, funeral home, or commercial wedding chapel. -- Motor vehicle fueling station. -- Nursery, garden shop, or plant sales. -- Personal service uses. -- Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service. [RAR] -- Temporary retail use. -- Theater.

(k) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(l) Utility and public service uses.

-- Commercial radio or television transmitting station. -- Electrical substation. -- Local utilities. -- Police or fire station. -- Post office. -- Radio, television, or microwave tower. [SUP] -- Tower/antenna for cellular communication. [SUP if an SUP is required for this use in the CR Community Retail District; otherwise, by right.] -- Utility or government installation other than listed. [SUP]

(m) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- Mini-warehouse. [SUP] (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Prohibited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.106. MAIN USES PROHIBITED.

As in all zoning districts, those main uses not specifically listed as permitted main uses are prohibited. Prohibited main uses include, but are not limited to, the following:

-- Ambulance service. -- Alcoholic beverage establishments. -- Building repair and maintenance shop. -- Cemetery or mausoleum. -- Carnival or circus (temporary). -- Commercial amusement (inside). -- Commercial amusement (outside). -- Commercial parking lot or garage. -- Dance hall. -- Hotel or motel. -- Lodging or boarding house. -- Motor vehicle fueling station. -- Overnight general purpose shelter. -- Pawn shop. -- Recycling buy-back center. -- Recycling collection center. -- Recycling drop-off container.

-- Recycling drop-off for special occasion collection. -- Restaurant with drive-in or drive-through service. -- Sexually oriented business. -- Swap or buy shop. -- Temporary concrete or asphalt batching plant. -- Tool or equipment rental. -- Transit passenger station or transfer center. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) In general. Unless otherwise stated, the yard, lot, and space regulations of the CR Community Retail District, contained in Section 51A-4.122(b)(4), apply.

(b) Front, side, and rear yard. For a multifamily use, minimum front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development plan.

(c) Dwelling unit density.

(1) Except as otherwise provided below, maximum number of dwelling units permitted on the Property is 163.

(2) No building permit for new construction of a multifamily use may be issued on the Property unless the dwelling unit density is in compliance with the density requirements for a multifamily use contained in Section 51A-4.116(b)(4)(C)(ii), except that a maximum of 44.5 dwelling units per acre may be constructed if 20 percent of the units are standard affordable housing (SAH) units.

(d) Height. Maximum structure height for a multifamily use is 30 feet.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage for a multifamily use is as shown on the development plan.

(f) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(g) Stories. For a multifamily use, maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off street parking and loading for a multifamily use must be provided as shown on the development plan. For all other uses, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.110. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress for a multifamily use must be provided as shown on the development plan. For all other permitted uses, access is prohibited to Argo Street. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.113. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b) below, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(b) If a sign is within 100 feet of private property in a non-business zoning district, the provisions for non-business zoning districts apply to that sign. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.114. LIGHTING.

All outdoor lighting must be operational and maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code, and must be directed away from adjoining properties. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.115. HOURS OF OPERATION.

The permitted hours of operation for a commercial amusement (inside) use are 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-483.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 483 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. Nos. 23212; 26042)
